en: Ya heard me.

I vowed before I shipped off to Abashiri.

N' why I'm standin' here now.
What are you going to do?

en: Simple.
No surprise there.

Get ready, Baba!

Not the greatest.
You're not going to ask?
Don't give a damn.
A feeling? What is it?
My bro's still alive.
I'm in no position to ask this...
But please, let me go for now.
But... I'm not ready to die.
Not till I achieve my dream.
Good.

en: You play nice with Kitakata?
How do ya know about that?
That's how cops work.
Kitakata!? He's alive!?

"Yup. We rushed in
when we heard the shot."
You can quit frettin'.
Gives me a chance to run my mouth a bit.
Not a soul gonna disturb us here.
It was the Tojo Clan.
Don't believe me, huh?
Try this on for size, then.
Thought that'd interest you.
Safe to say the Tojo's a little panicked.
Morinaga?
One of Daigo Dojima's personal bodyguards.
Aoyama's dead!?
First Morinaga's boss Dojima goes missing.
Don't that strike you as odd?
Well, we do. But not just that.
My real goal in all this, well...
It's finding out who's pulling the strings.
The wolf among the Tojo Clan sheep.
Ya mean there's a traitor? In the Tojo?
Might finally be startin' to crumble.
You ask me, that Baba guy you were with...
Chances are high.
The hell's goin' on?
One thing is for certain.
And you're right in the center.
An essential piece in this upheaval puzzle.
You wanna help the Tojo Clan, don't you?
'Course you do, big guy.
Can't do much if you're not in Tokyo, though.
Ya don't gotta tell me that.
Ain't a one thing I can do now.
Oh yeah. Forgot to mention.
This bus is on its way to the airport.
And the Osaka PD's gonna crack it wide open.
And we want your help.
Think you're up for it?
Don't fuck with me.
The Tojo Clan's on its last legs.
So what, ya want me to be your police rat?
Well? You in?
I'm not sure what you're getting at.
Of course, I'm aware of your history.
Haruka Sawamura.

en: She just needs her edges smoothed.

"With time, I'm confident I can make her
the most dazzling jewel anyone's ever seen."
Entrust her to me, and she'll be a star.
On one condition, right?
You want me out of the picture.
The more they learn, the more connected they feel.
On the contrary, if that person seems unattainable...
It only further fuels the thirst for knowledge.
You mean Haruka's past.
Yes. Love can be a cruel thing.
Wouldn't you agree?
It's for her own good.

"If we erase your connection to Haruka,
I'll be able to protect her."
In short...
Got it. I've heard enough.
And your answer?
I'm not leaving. Not a chance.
So this is a matter of duty.
It's a lot deeper than that.
This is the path I've chosen in life.

"Now if you'll excuse me, I have things to do.
You can see yourself out."
I must say, I'm surprised.
Ok
This is where dreams come to die.
As long as you're here, that is.
What's that supposed to mean?

en: It was yes, of course.
But the truth is, they're all afraid.
Afraid of what?
That one day this fragile happiness will shatter.
Even their own aspirations.
Free to be true to themselves.
You know it deep down.
Who will be stronger in the end?
Not for others, but for yourself.
Pursue your own goal.
They won't have a want in the world.
I'll even let you choose your own replacement.
And I promise you. Haruka-chan will be a star.
My... wish?
What makes you so sure?
It's simple.
Because I wanted the same thing.
You had... the same dream?
Yes. As long as you find the right successor...
Ya gotta stick to the rhythm!
Take it from the top!
Yes, sir!

en: Not good enough!
How 'bout ya just call it quits?
I can do this.
Please, let me try again!
Yup, uh-huh.
Haruka Sawamura. She's with us.
Oh, yes! Naturally.
Sawamura is our brightest star.
Yeah, exactly!

"Seriously? You really meant that?
That would be wonderful!"
Yes, absolutely.
I see. That'd be great!
Thanks for calling. Bye, now!
...Yes, of course.
With all respect, ma'am.

"Ya seriously expect me to get her ready for
the Princess League with just a week left?"
Ain't a chance! We'd need months.
It's a little late for complaints.
She's a real diamond in the rough, yeah.
Then what's the problem?
You've said enough, Ogita.
Now shut your mouth and do as you're told.
I'm paying you well enough for at least that.
You and I signed a contract.
There would be consequences.
What do you say?
Oh, that's him!

"See him over there?
That's the producer, Manda-san."
Shall we?
Oh no. T-Set is with him.
They dropped us in favor of Osaka Talent...
They dropped in favor of Osaka Talent...
Shoot... T-Set is with him.
They dropped us for Osaka Talent.
Nothing for you to worry about, though.

"Oh, no problem there! You two draw
a bigger crowd than anyone!"

"Well, good luck today, girls!
Mai-chan, Azusa-chan, take care of yourselves!"
Thank you, sir!

"Hello there, Manda-san! 
It's Horie, from Dyna Chair!"
I thought we'd come say hello before the show.
Hot!
I'm so sorry!

en: Manda-san!

en: Just before the finals, too.
That's one way to introduce yourself.

"What's wrong with you?

Dyna Chair-san.

en: We're so sorry, Manda-san! Here!
I really can't apologize enough!
We're very sorry, sir!
It was an honest mistake, sir!
Long as ya don't make another in the finals.
Of all the rotten luck...
It's them!
Horie-san!

What's the big idea!?

"What's goin' on here?

Just who do ya think you're talkin' to, bitch?
The hell's a hack like you know about dancin'!?
Leave the teachin' to the pros, amateur!
Shut your trap!

en: So that's how it is.
You're fired. Gather your things and go.
<Italic>I'm</Italic> the only reason she's come as far as she has.
That ain't how the world works!

en: How long are you going to stand there?
You bitch!
Will I? There isn't a penalty clause, you know.
Read your contracts before you sign them.
What? I <Italic>did</Italic> read it!
Wait a sec.
Ya didn't!

"If there's a problem, you can
take it up with my lawyer."
You double-crossin'...!
Don't have the guts to hit me?
Fuck this!
Ogita-san!
Horie!
Let him go.
Ma'am!

"Are you all right, ma'am?
I'll go get some ice!"
Wait, Haruka!
Haruka. Horie.
Come in.
You wanted to see us?
A little makeup goes a long way.

"Even the plainest girl can shine
with proper technique."

"And a pretty girl like you?
It could really put you a grade above."

"Don't be content thinking you're
pretty enough just the way you are."

"But I'm not pretty.
Not even a little."
Refining your image is no easy task.

"But now that you're in the industry,
you have to be in constant pursuit of beauty."
Something funny?
I'm just happy.
Happy I lectured you?
I'm really glad.
I guess it's true, then.
That every girl needs a mother.
We'll spruce up that wardrobe of yours.
Do you mean it?
I <Italic>always</Italic> mean it.
Have I ever proven otherwise?
I will. And, um...
I appreciate all your help!

"You did good.
Good enough to make up for earlier."
Still, we must apologize for what happened!
I really am sorry, sir!
By the way, Haruka-chan.
Yes, sir?
That makeup. Did you do it yourself?
Oh, no. Our boss helped me.
That so? Park-san, huh?
Is there... something wrong with it?

"Didn't mean to offend. It's just,
when I look at Haruka-chan..."
Our Park-san?
Morning, noon, and night...

"Some women get more beautiful
every time you see them."
They're always changing, growing.
I could've sworn T-Set had it in the bag.

"But I'm starting to think you might
give 'em a run for their money."
Eh, don't mind me.
Anyhow, good luck in the Princess League, ya hear?
What? Just giving some friendly advice.
If you put her down again...
What'll you do? Huh?
If you insult Park-san again...
You'll be sorry.
Ooh, scary.
But you should know.

"If our agency wanted to,
it could crush yours under its heel."
Just like an ugly little brooch.
Think I'll make a little call.
This is the end for you and that hag.
Don't...
Please, don't do it.
What, is that it?
I'm begging you... Stop.

"Your head's not low enough. 
Come on, touch the ground."
Hey! What do you think you're doing!?

en: It's all right, Horie.
Park-san...

Yeah, whatever.
Go ahead and beg for their forgiveness.
Are you serious?

en: Quite.
Provided that's what you really want.
"Celebrities nowadays don't really get ""time off."""
Except when they're at home, maybe.
As soon as Haruka steps outside, she's on the clock.
I've seen it all too many times.
Will you fall into the same trap?

"Come on, Mai. These people clearly
can't take a joke."
Yeah. Bunch of idiots.
Mai. Azusa.

"You used to work for us, so let me
give you a little piece of advice."
Real talent doesn't lie.

"If you're afraid of the competition,
it typically means you doubt your own abilities."
Who, her? I'd hardly call her competition!

"Then why bother with her at all? You could
be using that time to hone your skills."
Come on.
Haruka. Thank you.
This is just...
Hm? I thought you got me a present.
But it's...
Silly me.
I'll be back soon.
I'm going to Tokyo tomorrow.

"So, I'm leaving Horie a memo
on things to do while I'm gone."
But... why are you writing it with your left hand?
Oh, that? Remember when Ogita pushed me down?
I hurt my right hand pretty badly in the fall.

"I don't understand.
I thought you were right-handed."
I am. But that wasn't the case at first.
They were quite strict about it.
Back then, it was common practice.
There. All done.
Mama! What's for dinner?
What do you want, Sa-chan?
Um... How 'bout curry!?
Curry it is, then!
Ya mean it? Let's go home and eat!
Okay, okay.
ctx: subtítulo de escena C3170 + diálogo uid000212ca

en: Well? Did that calm your nerves a bit?
Yes, very much so!

"Things will be ramping up again tomorrow.
This'll be our last chance to relax for a while."
Your lessons will be relentless.
Can you handle that?
Of course. I'll do whatever it takes.
Haruka?
ctx: subtítulo de escena C3180 + subtítulo de escena E5210 …

en: Here. I have a gift for you.
To thank you for the brooch.
What? But you've already given me so much.

"Don't worry about that.
Just open it."
Isn't this your pen, ma'am?

"Are you sure? This looks
really expensive!"

"It doesn't just <Italic>look</Italic> expensive.
It is. Take good care of it."
I'll treasure it.
That fountain pen has a story.
It's been my good luck charm ever since.
Wow. You must have been really nervous, huh?
That night was child's play in hindsight.

"In my case, my whole life
got turned upside down."
Well, when I debuted at eighteen...
I was already married.
To the man who gave me that pen.

"I was already hiding both my troubled
upbringing and my Korean ancestry."
It went surprisingly fine for a time.
But one day...
I realized I had gotten pregnant.
I got rid of it right away.
I didn't hesitate much at the time.
I didn't tell my husband until afterward.
He had never hit me before that.
And then... he left.
I accepted it as another necessary sacrifice.

"But not long after, my agency found out
that I had been secretly married."
They were hesitant to promote me after that.
My scandal was a ticking timebomb waiting to blow.
So naturally they didn't want to invest in me.
Event after event was scratched off my schedule.

"You were such a big deal, ma'am.
I had no idea."
That concert was my dream.
A crowd of 55,000.

"Not bad for a girl who wasn't
even loved by her own parents."
Silly, right?

"Forget the concert. I could
barely even book a gig after that."
Until finally, even the smallest leads dried up.

"Thinking back on it, maybe that's why
I wanted to help develop a successful idol."

"Perhaps I'm just struggling to
find some form of redemption."
Either way, this is all I have left.
Sorry to have dragged you into this.

"Don't say that! I'll work hard,
for you and me both, ma'am."
Thank you, Haruka.

en: And you know...

"My ex-husband naturally caught wind...
and sent me this letter."
He asked me to meet him in Tokyo.
Truth be told, I thought I'd never see him again.
Until now, I hadn't heard a single word from him.
Ma'am...
